专业产品经理与软件工程师审查规格；题目初稿由LLM生成，灵感来自咨询案例、自由职: Professional product managers and software engineers review the specifications; first drafts of the questions are generated by an LLM, drawing on consulting cases, freelance development tasks, and patterns of startup applications.

ARC-AGI Toolkit软件MIT；不据此推断全部游戏内容或私有测试环境也: The ARC-AGI Toolkit software is MIT; this is not a basis for inferring that all game content or the private test environment is also MIT, and the license for the latter is Unverified.
BioPRM 正文与参考文献明确引用 BioProBench 的协议排序、错误识: The BioPRM text and references explicitly cite BioProBench tasks such as protocol ordering and error identification; this is an H2 academic citation.

Anthropic、OpenAI：API额度；Bugcrowd：研究者资助；作者: Anthropic and OpenAI: API credits; Bugcrowd: researcher funding; the authors state that outside parties did not affect the report's conclusions.
262名医生，覆盖26专科与60国执业经历；论文列49种医生可贡献语言，不将此自: 262 physicians, covering 26 specialties and practice experience in 60 countries; the paper lists 49 languages in which physicians can contribute, and this is not automatically taken as the dataset's exact language distribution.
93 名具有 Python 经验的专业开发者；先通过 50 道高置信 onboa: 93 professional developers with Python experience; they first pass 50 high-confidence onboarding questions and receive feedback.
论文首页11位作者统一署名Scale AI；这里记录公开论文机构，不把说话人或未: The 11 authors on the first page of the paper are all affiliated with Scale AI; this records the institution named in the public paper and does not infer that speakers or uncredited contributors are collaborating institutions.
不得与正式AIME 2024/2025混算；运行版本、重复次数、API错误处理及: It must not be calculated together with the official AIME 2024/2025; the run version, the number of repeats, API error handling, and the answer-extraction rules must all be stated together.
原始Video-MME；官方2024-06-15刷新破损/潜在失效视频链接并重新: The original Video-MME; on 2024-06-15 the official maintainers refreshed broken or potentially invalid video links and reannotated them, without naming a separate numeric version.
论文收集GRE/GMAT风格网络题种子并用众包扩展；官方README强调公开re: The paper collected seeds of GRE/GMAT-style questions from the web and expanded them by crowdsourcing; the official README emphasizes that the public release is the complete crowdsourced data.
删除个人信息或以合成信息替换；3名独立评审多数票，官网报告Automation: Personal information is deleted or replaced with synthetic information; a majority vote of 3 independent reviewers, and the official site reports an Automation Rate agreement of 94.4%.
厂商发布文实际报告ExploitBench结果；不同harness及私有June: Vendor release posts actually report ExploitBench results; different harnesses and the private June–August variants are not placed on the same leaderboard.
官方代码与反馈由 dsbowen/strong_reject 仓库提供；个人持续: Official code and feedback are provided by the dsbowen/strong_reject repository; individual responsibility for continued maintenance, and response-time limits, have not been verified.
从生成回答中抽取答案选项，官方提供多种答案抽取策略；原论文脚本无法匹配答案时使用: Answer choices are extracted from generated responses, and several answer-extraction strategies are provided officially; the original-paper script falls back to a random choice when it cannot match an answer, and a reproduction must record the implementation.
静态题 eval.py；动态题 eval_dynamic.py；提交静态预测格式: Static questions use eval.py; dynamic questions use eval_dynamic.py; the format for submitted static predictions includes id and pred.
官方GitHub LICENSE与HF数据卡均声明MIT；仅据发布者声明记录，不: Both the official GitHub LICENSE and the HF dataset card declare MIT; this is recorded only from the publisher's statement, and rights in third-party materials are not automatically extended.
8,316个可独立评分叶节点；新VM执行reproduce.sh后裁判评分；另用: 8,316 leaf nodes that can be scored independently; a new VM runs reproduce.sh and then a judge scores the result; JudgeEval is also used to test the judge.
冻结rubric对持久证据事后重评；离线游戏原生状态、在线体育视频扫描及人工疑难: Persistent evidence is rescored after the fact against a frozen rubric; offline native game state, online sports-video scanning, and human review of difficult cases; recording signatures and hash verification.
自然语言指令和政策为英文，结构化工具调用及SQL verifier；公开HF样例: Natural-language instructions and policies are in English, with structured tool calls and an SQL verifier; the public HF examples are in English, and cross-language coverage is not claimed.

论文声明题目为原创假设事实场景，无真实客户信息、个人可识别信息或特权/机密材料；: The paper states that the questions are original hypothetical factual scenarios, containing no real client information, no personally identifiable information, and no privileged or confidential material; the participating lawyers were paid and consented to the use.
MIT（本项目代码）；汇编数据继承来源约束：README注明部分来源无许可，不能: MIT (this project's code); the assembled data inherit the constraints of their sources: the README notes that some sources have no license, so MIT cannot be applied directly to all of the data.
只收录官方公开项目反馈渠道；执行生成代码时遵循仓库建议使用容器隔离，不将运行示例: Only officially public project feedback channels are included; when generated code is executed, the repository's recommendation to use container isolation is followed, and run examples are not treated as local instructions that can be executed directly.
Net Score（-100至100）、accuracy、hallucinati: Net Score (-100 to 100), accuracy, and hallucination rate; the three are different.
mini-SWE-agent、1000步、6小时，离线cleanroom；Val: mini-SWE-agent, 1000 steps, 6 hours, offline cleanroom; Vals unifies the bash tool and the sandbox.
原版 MMMU 的部分题目不看图也能答对，四选一又容许猜测。Pro通过过滤、扩展: Some questions in the original MMMU can be answered correctly without looking at the image, and four choices also allow guessing. Pro tightens the evaluation by filtering, expanding the options, and requiring vision-only input.
独立榜，不计入 AA Intelligence Index；pass^5 与 p: An independent leaderboard, not included in the AA Intelligence Index; the pass^5 and pass@1 rankings differ substantially.
不以学历分级；覆盖来源查找诊断、筛选汇总、比率/趋势/敏感性、损益模型、现金/资: It is not graded by academic degree; it covers five workflows: source finding and diagnosis, screening and aggregation, ratios/trends/sensitivity, profit-and-loss models, and cash/balance-sheet/valuation.
技能与任务答案解耦，扫描实例文件名、魔数、原样oracle命令或预期输出泄漏；不: Skills are decoupled from the task answers, and instance filenames, magic numbers, verbatim oracle commands, and expected outputs are scanned for leakage; complete exclusion of pretraining contamination cannot be guaranteed.
20篇ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral论文，共8,316项可独立: 20 ICML 2024 Spotlight and Oral papers, totaling 8,316 rubric subtasks that can be scored independently.
发布文明确在ExploitBench测试Astra及上一代模型；仅记录采用，不比: The release post explicitly tests Astra and the previous-generation model on ExploitBench; only adoption is recorded, and scores from different harnesses are not compared.
